name: Greece
spiritual_teacher: Mount Athos (World center of Orthodox hesychasm and monastic asceticism)
work_strategy: Remote (Digital Nomad Visa: 50% tax discount for the first 7 years)
ua_fop_and_local_taxes: First 183 days 0 €; thereafter progressive PIT + mandatory EFKA contributions; Ukrainian 5% single tax is not credited under DTT.
climate: Very warm (Mediterranean, mild snowless winter on the coast, 300+ sunny days)
nature: Top Sea and Islands (Aegean and Ionian seas, Mount Olympus, thousands of coves)
english_level: Moderate (Fluent English in tourism and major cities)
housing_rent: Moderate (~350–450 € in Thessaloniki or Athens suburbs)

protection_and_aid_2026.entry_documents: Biometric passport (without documents — only via the Promachonas border crossing).
protection_and_aid_2026.protection_status: Temporary Protection until March 4, 2027. ΑΦΜ (tax ID) and ΑΜΚΑ (social security) numbers are issued simultaneously.
protection_and_aid_2026.military_liable_rule_2026: **From 31.07.2026, EU countries do not grant protection to military-liable persons without proof of legal exit and deferment.**
protection_and_aid_2026.social_benefits: Virtually no state cash benefits (only humanitarian parcels and aid for those registered in RICs/ESTIA).
protection_and_aid_2026.housing_aid: Short-term accommodation at the Sintiki center; long-term housing via the HELIOS/ESTIA program.
protection_and_aid_2026.healthcare: Free care in public hospitals with an AMKA number; emergency care is free.
protection_and_aid_2026.transport: Free rides on the Athens metro (Athena Card) and in Thessaloniki with AMKA.
protection_and_aid_2026.work_rights: Automatic right to work with Temporary Protection. Minimum wage ~910 €. Seasonal employment in tourism.
